opening.argument: The instructions direct viewers to connect a MetaMask wallet and send liquidity to a new contract, while the speaker states, “You're going to have to send gas money to run this contract.” The process is presented as an arbitrage opportunity through repeated Uniswap transactions, with the flash loan supposedly repaid automatically and profits returned to the wallet within seconds or minutes. The speaker further presents the method as repeatable, saying, “you could do this all day long.” Together, these directions require wallet funds and contract execution while promising rapid, recurring returns.

citations.quote: This will connect to your metamask wallet so that you can interact with the contract
Go to your metamask or any wallet and send the liquidity to the new contract code.
You're going to have to send gas money to run this contract.
The flash loan will be paid back automatically and any profit will be returned to your wallet in a few seconds/minutes.
you could do this all day long.
